title: Chapter 3 Revision — Passive Voice (być + PPP)
title_fa: مرور فصل ۳ B1: صدای مجهول با być
description: Mixed revision quiz covering być + PPP state passive, PPP gender/number agreement, 15 common passive verbs, and passive in real-world contexts (signs, transport, descriptions).

questions.prompt: Sklep jest ___. (The shop is closed.) [PPP of zamknąć, masc]
questions.explanation: 'Sklep' (shop) is masculine → PPP masculine: 'zamknięty'. From zamknąć → zamknięty (irregular: -nąć → -nięty). Compare: 'Restauracja jest zamknięta' (f), 'Muzeum jest zamknięte' (n).

questions.prompt: Okno jest ___. (The window is open.) [PPP of otworzyć, neuter]
questions.explanation: 'Okno' (window) is neuter → PPP neuter: 'otwarte'. From otworzyć → otwarty/otwarta/otwarte (irregular — stem change). 'Okno jest otwarte' = the window is open (state passive).

questions.prompt: Wszyscy uczestnicy są ___. (All participants are invited.) [virile pl PPP of zaprosić]
questions.explanation: 'Uczestnicy' (participants — mixed/male group = virile plural) → virile PPP: 'zaproszeni'. Non-virile (women-only): 'uczestniczki są zaproszone'. Virile plural -eni/-ani: zaproszeni, budowani, zrobieni.

questions.prompt: Drzwi są ___. (The doors are closed.) [drzwi = always plural, non-virile]
questions.explanation: 'Drzwi' (doors) is always plural and non-virile → non-virile PPP: 'zamknięte'. NEVER 'zamknięty' (that would be singular masculine). Key fact: drzwi has no singular form in Polish.

questions.prompt: Kolacja jest ___. (Dinner/supper is cooked.) [PPP of ugotować — 'kolacja' is feminine]
questions.explanation: 'Kolacja' (supper/dinner) is feminine → PPP feminine: 'ugotowana'. Note: 'obiad jest ugotowany' (m — lunch/dinner). 'ugotować' → ugotown-y/-a/-e (regular -ować → -owany pattern).

questions.prompt: Bilety są ___. (The tickets are sold out.) [PPP of wyprzedać — bilety = pl non-virile]
questions.explanation: 'Bilety' (tickets, m inanimate plural) = non-virile plural → PPP non-virile: 'wyprzedane'. Virile (male people) would be 'wyprzedani' — but tickets are objects, not people. Objects are always non-virile.

'ZAREZERWOWANE' = RESERVED (neuter PPP of zarezerwować — signs use neuter by convention). Compare signs: ZAMKNIĘTE (CLOSED), OTWARTE (OPEN), ZAJĘTE (OCCUPIED/TAKEN), WOLNE (FREE/AVAILABLE — actually an adjective).

questions.prompt: Pociąg do Warszawy jest ___ o 15 minut. (The train to Warsaw is delayed by 15 minutes.) ['pociąg' = m]
questions.explanation: 'Pociąg' (train) is masculine → PPP masculine: 'opóźniony'. From opóźnić → opóźnion-y. Common transport passive: lot odwołany (m), kasa zamknięta (f), metro opóźnione (n).

questions.prompt: What is the PPP of 'znaleźć' (to find)?
questions.explanation: From 'znaleźć' → PPP: 'znaleziony/znaleziona/znalezione' (irregular — stem change: znaleź- → znalezion-). 'Klucz jest znaleziony' = the key is found. This is one of the most common irregular PPPs — must be memorized.

questions.prompt: Which construction expresses a STATE? (The report is done — it describes the current situation.)
questions.explanation: 'Raport jest zrobiony' = być + PPP → STATE passive (what IS the situation right now). 'Zostanie zrobiony' = zostać + PPP → EVENT passive (the action of it being done — Ch4). 'Zrobi się' = reflexive. 'Zrobiła sekretarka' = active voice.

questions.prompt: Which PPP form is INCORRECT for 'wysłać'?
questions.explanation: 'Wysłaniony' does NOT exist — it is wrong! From wysłać → wysłan-y/-a/-e (Pattern 4: -ać with -an stem). The -iony suffix applies to -ić/-yć verbs (robić → robiony). Never mix patterns: wysłać → wysłany (not *wysłaniony).

questions.prompt: Projekt jest skończony i raport jest ___. (The project is finished and the report is written.) ['raport' = m]
questions.explanation: 'Raport' (report) is masculine → PPP masculine: 'napisany'. Both 'projekt' and 'raport' are masculine → both take masculine PPP forms: 'Projekt jest skończony i raport jest napisany.' Full sentence: perfect coordination of two state passives.
